description_sq:
Ne rrugen Naim Frasheri tek Mozaiku shitet apartament 1+1 me siperfaqe 40m², kati 1 ,pallat ekzistues.
Apartamenti eshte i rikonstruktuar totalisht ,me instalime te reja .

description_en: On Naim Frasheri street, near Mozaiku, a 1+1 apartment with a surface area of ​​40 m² is for sale, on the 1st floor, in the existing building. The apartment is completely reconstructed, with new installations. It is located in one of the most sought-after areas for housing and investment. (Can be sold together with an adjacent apartment). Price 105000 Euro.
